reviews.implementation_scope_note: Typed pinned upstream adapter and native validation cover explicitly tested operations; historical-version and full-paper parity remain unvalidated. R API behavior and the actual read/pair and strand choices need reconstruction. cbind, DESeq2 rlog, correlations and PCA are separate steps.

reviews.use_summary: Quantified yeast RNA-seq against R64-1-1 using Rsubread featureCounts after BCLConvert demultiplexing and DRAGEN RNA processing. The paragraph reports Rsubread 2.23.2 with R 4.4.1.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Typed pinned upstream adapter and native validation cover explicitly tested operations; historical-version and full-paper parity remain unvalidated. Preserve the literal reported versions without normalizing them. Rsubread API, cloud DRAGEN processing and DESeq2 1.48.1 are separate from standalone Subread 2.1.1.

reviews.use_summary: Counted RNA-seq gene alignments with featureCounts in Subread 2.0.1 against GENCODE v41 basic, after Cutadapt/seqtk/STAR and UMI-tools 1.0.1 deduplication.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Typed pinned upstream adapter and native validation cover explicitly tested operations; historical-version and full-paper parity remain unvalidated. The prior UMI deduplication must be explicit; featureCounts does not perform it. DESeq2 donor adjustment and subsequent enrichment are separate.

reviews.use_summary: Generated mouse mm10 gene-overlap counts using featureCounts 1.5.1 after STAR 2.5.2b alignment.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Typed pinned upstream adapter and native validation cover explicitly tested operations; historical-version and full-paper parity remain unvalidated. A stranded library description does not establish the exact featureCounts -s option. DESeq2, biomaRt, AUCell and enrichment remain separate.

reviews.use_summary: Counted Toxoplasma gondii ME49 gene-aligned reads with featureCounts after Subread 2.0.1 alignment to ToxoDB release 49.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Typed pinned upstream adapter and native validation cover explicitly tested operations; historical-version and full-paper parity remain unvalidated. TPMCalculator expression normalization and iDEP/DESeq2 testing are separate. Subread alignment flags -d 50 -D 600 --sortReadsByCoordinates are not featureCounts options.

reviews.use_summary: Reported FeatureCounts 2.0.0 for read quantification alongside STAR 2.7.3a in the study software methods.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Typed pinned upstream adapter and native validation cover explicitly tested operations; historical-version and full-paper parity remain unvalidated. The paragraph lists software; exact annotation, strand, units and counting filters are unspecified. Do not infer all settings from the STAR version or neighboring software list.

reviews.use_summary: Used featureCounts 2.0.1 after Subjunc 2.0.1 mapping to the Longmi4 millet genome; the source describes read counts and FPKM expression.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Typed pinned upstream adapter and native validation cover explicitly tested operations; historical-version and full-paper parity remain unvalidated. Read assignment and FPKM normalization require separate count-unit, exon-length and mapped-library denominator contracts. DESeq2, InterProScan and KO annotation are separate.

reviews.use_summary: Reported featureCounts 2.0.2 expression quantification as transcripts per kilobase of exon model per million mapped reads after STAR 2.4.2 mapping to PNT2T grape assemblies.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Typed pinned upstream adapter and native validation cover explicitly tested operations; historical-version and full-paper parity remain unvalidated. Preserve the source wording. Standalone raw counts do not by themselves establish transcript abundance or the paper normalization denominator; genomic-length TPM/FPKM helpers are explicitly different contracts.

reviews.use_summary: Generated gene counts with featureCounts in Subread 1.4.6-p4 against GENCODE v22 comprehensive GRCh38 after Trimmomatic and STAR 2.4.1a.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Typed pinned upstream adapter and native validation cover explicitly tested operations; historical-version and full-paper parity remain unvalidated. Legacy featureCounts paired -p semantics differ from Subread >=2.0.2. DESeq2 Wald testing and EnrichR are separate.

reviews.use_summary: Counted genes/biotypes using featureCounts in Subread 2.0.3 after STAR 2.7.9a alignment with the stated GRCh38/Ensembl 105 reference.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Typed pinned upstream adapter and native validation cover explicitly tested operations; historical-version and full-paper parity remain unvalidated. A separate RSEM projection and aggregation generated another count matrix; do not merge the two quantifier provenances. Picard, dupRadar, RSeQC and Snakemake QC remain separate.

reviews.use_summary: Counted ATAC pseudobulk BAM overlaps with merged cell-type peaks using featureCounts, before EDASeq GC correction and DESeq2 size-factor/marker analyses.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Typed pinned upstream adapter and native validation cover explicitly tested operations; historical-version and full-paper parity remain unvalidated. These features are peaks, not gene exons. Hepatocyte 10% downsampling (seed 123), peak calling/merging and mean-count >=10 filtering are separate stages.

reviews.use_summary: Generated gene counts using featureCounts for paired 75-bp SAT RNA-seq from BMI-discordant monozygotic twins after STAR two-pass mapping to hg38/Ensembl 104.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Typed pinned upstream adapter and native validation cover explicitly tested operations; historical-version and full-paper parity remain unvalidated. Paired sequencing does not specify whether the reported counts are reads or fragments, or the featureCounts strand/filter settings. Picard QC and downstream models remain separate.

reviews.use_summary: Used Rsubread/seqinr featureCounts and juncCounts with custom GENCODE transcript annotations to extract splice-junction read counts.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Typed pinned upstream adapter and native validation cover explicitly tested operations; historical-version and full-paper parity remain unvalidated. This is a junction workflow. Salmon generated the separate gene-count input for edgeR; HISAT2/StringTie/Ballgown alignment/assembly, R package objects and exact custom annotation behavior are not reproduced by a generic gene counter.

reviews.use_summary: Generated exon-based raw gene counts with featureCounts 2.0.0 for 60,617 genes and 4,778 samples after a Nextflow/STAR 2.7.3.a two-pass RNA-seq workflow.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Typed pinned upstream adapter and native validation cover explicitly tested operations; historical-version and full-paper parity remain unvalidated. Merged splice junctions, Ensembl 97 GRCh38 and STAR sjdbOverhang 75 belong to the alignment contract. This old version predates the modern separation of -p and --countReadPairs.

reviews.use_summary: Counted GRCh38 iPSC/differentiated-cell RNA-seq alignments with featureCounts after HISAT2, excluding multi-mapped reads.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Typed pinned upstream adapter and native validation cover explicitly tested operations; historical-version and full-paper parity remain unvalidated. Exclusion depends on the aligner multiplicity tags/policy. Directional library chemistry alone does not specify the exact counting-strand option.

reviews.use_summary: Aligned ONT reads for splicing analyses using minimap2 2.22--r1109dirty: -ax splice -C 0 for SOS, and default -ax splice for hybrid/SOS/F19B2.5.2 UTR analyses.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Typed pinned upstream adapter and native validation cover explicitly tested operations; historical-version and full-paper parity remain unvalidated. The dirty historical build and distinct runs must remain explicit. IsoQuant 3.5.0 assembly/correction settings are separate; splice and direct-RNA library orientations cannot be inferred.

reviews.use_summary: Mapped ONT reads with minimap2 2.22 using -x map-ont -a --secondary=no --MD to sex-specific XY/XO hg38 or T2T-CHM13 references.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Typed pinned upstream adapter and native validation cover explicitly tested operations; historical-version and full-paper parity remain unvalidated. BWA-MEM2 was used for Illumina reads separately. Suppressing secondary output does not establish unique mapping; reference composition and downstream variant comparison remain explicit.

reviews.use_summary: Mapped ONT direct-RNA reads using minimap2 before SAMtools conversion/sorting in the Toxoplasma study.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Typed pinned upstream adapter and native validation cover explicitly tested operations; historical-version and full-paper parity remain unvalidated. The precise mapping preset/settings refer to a prior protocol and are not specified here. Guppy >5.0.1 basecalling and quality >7 selection are separate.

reviews.use_summary: Mapped selected metagenomic short reads to assemblies using minimap2 2.24 -ax sr, followed by SAMtools 1.16.1 view -Sb -F 2308 and sorting.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Typed pinned upstream adapter and native validation cover explicitly tested operations; historical-version and full-paper parity remain unvalidated. MetaBAT2 depth/binning and SingleM/BinChicken orchestration remain separate; SAM flag filtering must not be silently folded into raw mapping.

reviews.use_summary: Aligned masked bat genomes at the assembly level with minimap2 before SyRI structural comparison and plotsr visualization.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Typed pinned upstream adapter and native validation cover explicitly tested operations; historical-version and full-paper parity remain unvalidated. The exact minimap2 preset/options are unspecified. Assembly masking, chromosome/scaffold selection, SyRI rearrangement calls and plotsr output are separate.

reviews.use_summary: Mapped filtered HiFi reads to both haplotypes using minimap2 2.26-r1175 -ax map-hifi --cs=short --eqx --MD.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Typed pinned upstream adapter and native validation cover explicitly tested operations; historical-version and full-paper parity remain unvalidated. The current 2.31 writer emits MD rather than cs when both are requested; the adapter warns. HiFiAdapterFilt and later -F 0x900/MAPQ60/shared-read/chromosome/strand restrictions are separate.

reviews.use_summary: Used minimap2 2.24-r1122 HiFi alignments to inspect millet structural-variant breakpoints, including manual IGV assessment of 304 loci spanning 3-17 kb.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Typed pinned upstream adapter and native validation cover explicitly tested operations; historical-version and full-paper parity remain unvalidated. The exact mapping preset is unspecified. Manual IGV validation and separate Hi-C/Juicebox assessment cannot be inferred from alignment output.

reviews.use_summary: Aligned ONT reads to grape assemblies with minimap2 2.26 to assess split-read gaps and assembly continuity in IGV.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Typed pinned upstream adapter and native validation cover explicitly tested operations; historical-version and full-paper parity remain unvalidated. The exact minimap2 preset/settings are unspecified. Hifiasm, NextDenovo, RagTag, Juicer/3D-DNA assembly, gap closing and polishing are separate.

reviews.use_summary: Mapped ONT tumor/normal reads to GRCh37 using minimap2 2.17 before multiple structural-variant callers and consensus selection.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Typed pinned upstream adapter and native validation cover explicitly tested operations; historical-version and full-paper parity remain unvalidated. cuteSV, SAVANA, SVIM and Sniffles2 calling/consensus are separate from mapping; no variant caller or historical version parity is implied.

reviews.use_summary: Mapped F1 ONT reads to a combined two-T2T reference using minimap2 2.17-r941, converting PAF to BED and bedtools genomecov for centromeric coverage assessment.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Typed pinned upstream adapter and native validation cover explicitly tested operations; historical-version and full-paper parity remain unvalidated. The >70 coverage threshold was about twice sequencing coverage. Reference composition, PAF target/query orientation and downstream coverage/filtering remain explicit.

reviews.use_summary: Mapped ONT reads to 14 wheat chromosomes using minimap2 2.24 for chromosome-wise NextDenovo assembly, and aligned contigs to organelle references with -cx asm20.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Typed pinned upstream adapter and native validation cover explicitly tested operations; historical-version and full-paper parity remain unvalidated. Organelle filtering required >=95% organelle sequence and <=5% divergence; these aggregate contig rules are separate from a PAF alignment or its per-alignment identity.

reviews.use_summary: Mapped 800-1,800-bp ONT TMEM216 transcript reads to GRCh38 with minimap2 2.22 after Porechop/NanoFilt filtering, then inspected alleles in IGV.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Typed pinned upstream adapter and native validation cover explicitly tested operations; historical-version and full-paper parity remain unvalidated. The exact mapping preset is unspecified. Basecalling, Q>=10/length filtering, BAM conversion and manual allele interpretation are separate.

reviews.use_summary: Aligned phased HPRC/HGSVC/NHP assemblies to CHM13 using minimap2 2.24 with CIGAR inclusion, secondary alignments suppressed, stated divergence <10% and minimum peak alignment score 25,000.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Typed pinned upstream adapter and native validation cover explicitly tested operations; historical-version and full-paper parity remain unvalidated. Retain the stated divergence criterion without inventing its CLI flag. rustybam locus extraction, seqtk sequence retrieval and subsequent MAFFT/IQ-TREE phylogeny are separate.

reviews.use_summary: Used minimap2 for long-read mapping within Locityper WGS preprocessing against a predefined background region for insert-size, error-profile and read-depth modeling.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Typed pinned upstream adapter and native validation cover explicitly tested operations; historical-version and full-paper parity remain unvalidated. This is a Locityper-internal step; Strobealign handled short reads. Read recruitment/subsampling and the Locityper probabilistic model are not standalone minimap2 behavior.

reviews.use_summary: Aligned high-quality long reads to cucumber genome assemblies with minimap2 2.17-r941 as an assembly-integrity assessment.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Typed pinned upstream adapter and native validation cover explicitly tested operations; historical-version and full-paper parity remain unvalidated. The exact mapping preset/settings are unspecified. BUSCO gene completeness, BWA short-read assessment, RagTag anchoring and Merqury k-mer/base-quality analyses are separate.

reviews.use_summary: Mapped H1-cell RNA-seq reads to hg38 with HISAT2 before SAMtools quality filtering and bedtools coverage/signal extraction at initiation zones and random regions.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Typed pinned upstream adapter and native validation cover explicitly tested operations; historical-version and full-paper parity remain unvalidated. No HISAT2 version/settings are specified. CUT&Run Bowtie2 preprocessing, coverage summation and interval-matched random controls are separate.

reviews.use_summary: Mapped paired 51-bp MCF7 xenograft RNA-seq reads to hg38/GRCh38 using HISAT2 2.1.0 before HTSeq count 0.5.3 and DESeq2 1.22.2 differential expression.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Typed pinned upstream adapter and native validation cover explicitly tested operations; historical-version and full-paper parity remain unvalidated. Strand-specific/UMI-containing library construction does not by itself establish RNA-strand or UMI-deduplication options. HTSeq counting and GSEA/clusterProfiler are separate.

reviews.use_summary: Aligned quality-trimmed paired 150-bp HSPC RNA-seq to mouse mm10 using HISAT2 2.2.1 before GENCODE M25/HTSeq-count 0.13.5 assignment.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Typed pinned upstream adapter and native validation cover explicitly tested operations; historical-version and full-paper parity remain unvalidated. Trim Galore flags belong to preprocessing. FPKM and log(FPKM+1) sample comparisons are separate from alignment.

reviews.use_summary: Mapped plant RNA-seq evidence to millet genomes with HISAT2 2.1.0 using --min-intronlen 20 --max-intronlen 15000, followed by StringTie2 2.1.7 transcript assembly.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Typed pinned upstream adapter and native validation cover explicitly tested operations; historical-version and full-paper parity remain unvalidated. The larger MAKER2 gene-annotation workflow also uses AUGUSTUS, SNAP, homology evidence and repeat annotation; alignment alone does not implement those stages.

reviews.use_summary: Mapped cleaned RNA-seq reads to ZS11 with reported HISAT2 2.1.2 defaults before SAMtools filtering of MAPQ<10, nonunique and unmapped reads.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Typed pinned upstream adapter and native validation cover explicitly tested operations; historical-version and full-paper parity remain unvalidated. Retain the reported version literally. StringTie 1.3.6 TPM estimation and SAMtools uniqueness/filter definitions are separate.

reviews.use_summary: Mapped RNA-seq evidence to repeat-masked grape assemblies with the reported Hisat2 2.10.2 before StringTie and combined BRAKER/PASA/MAKER gene annotation.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Typed pinned upstream adapter and native validation cover explicitly tested operations; historical-version and full-paper parity remain unvalidated. Preserve the literal reported version without silently correcting it. Repeat masking, transcript models, HMM/Pfam confidence filtering and TE annotations are separate.

reviews.use_summary: Mapped publicly sourced multispecies RNA-seq with HISAT2 2.2.1, restricting intron length to 40,000 bp.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Typed pinned upstream adapter and native validation cover explicitly tested operations; historical-version and full-paper parity remain unvalidated. StringTie TPM and stranded deepTools tracks were separate; Kallisto estimated counts fed the distinct DESeq2 differential-expression analysis.

reviews.use_summary: Used HISAT2 through CIRIquant to align RNA-seq to pseudo-circular circRNA references for junction-based circRNA quantification.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Typed pinned upstream adapter and native validation cover explicitly tested operations; historical-version and full-paper parity remain unvalidated. Pseudo-circle construction, back/forward-splice counts, CPM and 2*bsj/(2*bsj+fsj) ratios require CIRIquant integration. The single-end MSBB subset instead relied on CIRI2 back-splice counts.

reviews.use_summary: Mapped RNA-seq to the stated no-alt-plus-hs38d1 hg38 reference with HISAT2 2.1.0 --rna-strandness RF --downstream-transcriptome-assembly.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Typed pinned upstream adapter and native validation cover explicitly tested operations; historical-version and full-paper parity remain unvalidated. SAMtools 1.9 sorting/BAM/indexing, HTSeq 0.13 counting and limma/voom 3.44 testing are separate; the adapter exposes DTA explicitly.

reviews.use_summary: Used the HISAT2/StringTie/Ballgown short-read RNA-seq workflow to map paired 150-bp reads to GRCh38/hg38.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Typed pinned upstream adapter and native validation cover explicitly tested operations; historical-version and full-paper parity remain unvalidated. Salmon generated separate gene counts for edgeR, and custom Rsubread/seqinr junction extraction was another stage; the named workflow is not one aligner operation.

reviews.use_summary: Aligned directional-library RNA-seq from an iPSC panel/differentiated derivatives to GRCh38 with HISAT2 before featureCounts quantification excluding multi-mapped reads.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Typed pinned upstream adapter and native validation cover explicitly tested operations; historical-version and full-paper parity remain unvalidated. The exact HISAT2 version and RNA-strand option are unspecified. Library chemistry and downstream multiplicity exclusion do not identify all aligner settings.

reviews.use_summary: Aligned strand-specific RNA-seq from 29 reference-cultivar tissues to each of 125 cucumber assemblies with HISAT2 2.2.1.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Typed pinned upstream adapter and native validation cover explicitly tested operations; historical-version and full-paper parity remain unvalidated. BAM intron hints informed BRAKER2; StringTie 2.2.1 transcripts, GenomeThreader homology and EVidenceModeler gene-model integration/filtering are separate.

reviews.use_summary: Used RsubRead featureCounts to quantify mouse RNA-seq against mm9 GTF.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: R API/library-version and R object behavior remain separate from the standalone featureCounts adapter.

reviews.use_summary: Used the Rsubread featureCounts interface for yeast RNA-seq counts; reported version 2.23.2 with R 4.4.1.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Preserve literal versions; DRAGEN preprocessing and DESeq2 1.48.1 are separate.

reviews.use_summary: Used Rsubread featureCounts/juncCounts with custom GENCODE transcript annotations for junction-read extraction.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Standalone Subread junction counts are tested separately; no equivalence to R objects/custom juncCounts code is claimed.

reviews.use_summary: Used seqinr for biological sequence retrieval/analysis in a custom Rsubread junction-read extraction workflow.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: The exact seqinr functions are unspecified; generic Java FASTA access does not establish the full R package behavior.

reviews.use_summary: Aligned Toxoplasma RNA-seq to ME49/ToxoDB49 with Subread 2.0.1 using -d 50 -D 600 --sortReadsByCoordinates before featureCounts.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: The Subread aligner is a different executable and algorithm from HISAT2, STAR and the featureCounts counter; not implemented by those adapters.

reviews.use_summary: Mapped millet RNA-seq reads to Longmi4 with Subjunc 2.0.1 before featureCounts 2.0.1 quantification.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Subjunc splice alignment is distinct from the featureCounts counter; exact program integration remains pending.

reviews.use_summary: Constructed pseudo-circular circRNA references and realigned RNA-seq through HISAT2 for CIRIquant circRNA expression and circular-to-linear ratios.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: The pseudoreference, junction counting, CPM denominator and junc_ratio model remain unimplemented by standalone HISAT2.

reviews.use_summary: Used CIRI2-reported back-splice junction counts for circRNA quantification in the single-end MSBB cohort.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: The source explicitly distinguishes this subset from CIRIquant pseudo-reference realignment; not a generic HISAT2 feature.

reviews.use_summary: Removed predicted doublets independently per sample, after mitochondrial/count and gene-prevalence QC; concatenation, normalization to 10000, logarithm and Harmony followed.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Do not infer paper-specific Scrublet settings or pool the 35 loading samples before simulation.

reviews.use_summary: Called doublets per library using Scrublet with a cited two-step diffusion procedure; the source reports a greater-than-40-percent Scrublet-score filter alongside gene and mitochondrial QC.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: The custom diffusion procedure is not the original Scrublet pipeline exposed here; retain the literal threshold wording and reconcile the cited procedure.

reviews.use_summary: Applied Scrublet separately per MERFISH experiment with a score cutoff of 0.18, before segmentation-volume and expression filters and volume/total-count normalization.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: MERFISH measurement and segmentation assumptions differ from droplet UMI doublets. Explicit threshold support does not establish this whole spatial pipeline.

reviews.use_summary: Removed predicted chick-cell doublets by developmental stage with Scrublet thresholds between 0.2 and 0.3 after CellRanger or DropEst count generation.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Reconstruct the stage-specific thresholds and input layers; Scanpy, Harmony and Leiden are separate.

reviews.use_summary: Used Scrublet 0.2.3 with 10 principal components independently per batch; subsequent downsampling to 1000 UMIs, CPM and log transformation were separate.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Use the correct pre-downsampling count input and batch unit. scvi-tools reference label transfer is a separate method.

reviews.use_summary: Applied Scrublet to infer further doublets after initial quality filtering, normalization/log transformation and an initial Leiden clustering.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: The reported processing stage differs from a default raw-count run; exact matrix and modified preprocessing settings require reconstruction.

reviews.use_summary: Called doublets with the modified Scrublet workflow in SnapATAC2 on selected 500-bp accessibility tiles, with expected rate 0.08 and score cutoff 0.5.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: This is an ATAC-specific SnapATAC2 implementation, not execution of the original RNA Scrublet 0.2.3 adapter.

reviews.use_summary: Applied Scrublet to MERFISH profiles after volume correction and normalization to 250, using a score cutoff greater than 0.25 and removing about four percent.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Processed fractional input must be explicitly declared as estimates. Raw-UMI simulation assumptions and this spatial pipeline are not established by accepting those values.

reviews.use_summary: Called doublets using scanpy.pp.scrublet with defaults in Scanpy 1.10.4; later Pearson residuals and SysVI analyses were separate.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: The Scanpy wrapper is distinct from the original Scrublet package adapter and may change preprocessing and defaults.

reviews.use_summary: Computed Scrublet scores per 10x lane, then replaced scores by medians within Scanpy clusters/reclusters and used a right-tail normal approximation, MAD-derived spread and BH adjustment; marker review removed further clusters.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: The cluster-median statistical postprocessing and manual decisions are not implemented by the original score/threshold adapter. Exact units and tail calibration need source-code reconciliation.

reviews.use_summary: Applied Scrublet 0.2.3 with defaults per experiment after splitpipe and CellBender 0.2.0; percentile-based doublet/count/mitochondrial QC followed.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: A percentile QC rule differs from the package automatic threshold. Keep preprocessing, per-experiment grouping and downstream filters explicit.

reviews.use_summary: Called doublets independently per sample with Scrublet score threshold 0.15 before joining 295141 cells and subsequent normalization, regression and Harmony.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: The adapter exposes the threshold and library unit; cell-cycle regression and batch integration remain separate.

reviews.use_summary: Combined dataset-tuned Scrublet 0.0.2, DoubletDecon 1.1.5 and DoubletFinder 3 calls: removed all DoubletFinder calls or the intersection of DoubletDecon and Scrublet calls.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Original Scrublet 0.2.3 is a different version; the multi-tool Boolean rule and other callers are separate pending workflows.

reviews.use_summary: Used Scrublet for doublet removal after RT-primer-aware cell merging and quality filtering in a large single-cell dataset.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: The RT-primer cell construction, exact settings and downstream Monocle testing are separate contracts.

reviews.use_summary: Used default Scrublet during Scanpy 1.10.3 preprocessing and also manually removed clusters expressing mixed-lineage markers.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Automatic doublet scores do not replace the manual mixed-marker review or the separate Harmony/Leiden stages.

reviews.use_summary: Ran Scrublet 0.2.3 and scds 1.18 per sample after CellRanger 7 and CellBender 0.1.0 processing.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: The source does not specify the combination rule; do not invent a union or intersection of the two callers.

reviews.use_summary: Used Scrublet 0.2.3 to remove predicted doublets in the single-cell preprocessing workflow.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Harmony and cell-cycle principal-component regression are separate; their reported versions do not establish Scrublet settings.

reviews.use_summary: Ran Scrublet separately per sequencing run after CellRanger 3.0.2 and SoupX 1.3, before Seurat 3 analysis.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Ambient-RNA correction and the exact run-level input matrix must be retained separately; no legacy Seurat/Scrublet parity is inferred.

reviews.use_summary: Used Seurat 5.1 SCTransform defaults for clustering and visualization after CellRanger 8.0.1 aggregation; differential expression and other analyses used a separately NormalizeData-processed RNA layer.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Keep SCT residuals, corrected counts, logdata and the separate RNA analysis layer distinct.

reviews.use_summary: Applied Seurat 4.3.0.1 SCTransform while regressing S.Score and G2M.Score. ADT CLR normalization, HTODemux, Harmony and WNN were separate.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Seurat post-fit vars.to.regress differs from standalone vst latent variables. The adapter tests phase-score regression, not WNN or demultiplexing.

reviews.use_summary: Used SCTransform-normalized counts in spatial receptor-ligand expression correlations with a 100-micrometre adjacency definition.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Establish the exact SCT count layer; LIANA candidate selection, distances and correlations are separate.

reviews.use_summary: Reported SCTransform 0.4.3 normalization/scaling before scDist 1.1.5 differential-state analysis.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: SCTransform fitting does not implement scDist or the separate scCODA composition analysis.

reviews.use_summary: Used Seurat 5.1 SCTransform for spatial PDAC and myocardial-infarction profiles, followed by a top-ten-percent variable-gene choice, scaling, 20-PC analysis and Leiden clustering.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: HVG selection, additional ScaleData and neighborhood/clustering choices must be reconstructed independently.

reviews.use_summary: Used Seurat 4 SCTransform with 3000 highly variable genes; DoubletFinder removed the top ten percent per sample and Harmony/orthologue/RPCA integration followed.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: DoubletFinder is separate from Scrublet, and SCT fitting does not implement the integration pipeline.

reviews.use_summary: Applied SCTransform separately to 10x and SSv4 profiles, using 25 versus 30 principal components and an SCT integration workflow with 3000 anchors.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: PrepSCTIntegration, FindIntegrationAnchors and IntegrateData are separate operations, not implied by a fitted SCT model.

reviews.use_summary: Used Seurat SCTransform regularized negative-binomial normalization of RNA before highly variable-gene PCA; antibody-derived tags used CLR separately.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: The adapter handles RNA count models, not ADT CLR or the full multimodal workflow.

reviews.use_summary: Applied standalone sctransform 0.4.2 vst() to bulk liver counts for PCA-based outlier detection. edgeR TMM/CPM and rank-based testing were separate.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: This is standalone vst on bulk data, not Seurat SCTransform or DESeq2 variance stabilization. Current 0.4.3 fitting and biological assumptions need version/input reconciliation.

reviews.use_summary: Applied SCTransform and PCA in the merged Seurat RNA workflow, which also describes NormalizeData/ScaleData and a literal nFeature_RNA less-than-1000 AND less-than-5000 filter.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Preserve the conflicting/redundant filter wording for reconciliation; do not silently replace it with a conventional interval.

reviews.use_summary: Repeated SCTransform and integration using NS-Forest-selected marker anchors versus random anchors for comparison.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: NS-Forest marker discovery and anchor-based integration are separate from normalization.

reviews.use_summary: Applied SCTransform to RCTD-derived cell-type expression estimates, including summed adrenocortical/mesenchymal estimates and a spot-total filter of at least 1500.
